title: Trivial kernel of additive cohomology tensor pullback
statement: Let $k\to k'$ be an algebra map of fields. Let $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one [def-sc-curves], and let $C'$ with maps $f',j$ be a displayed cartesian base change along $\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$. Let $G,G'$ be abelian sheaves on the respective small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with natural additive section equivalences $a_U:G(U)\simeq\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ and $a'_{U'}:G'(U')\simeq\Gamma(U',\mathcal O_{U'})$. Let $q:j^*G\to G'$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] have adjoint section map given under these coordinates by structural pullback. Equip $H^1(G)$ and $H^1(G')$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] with $k$- and $k'$-module structures, respectively. Assume that for every scalar there is a sheaf endomorphism which multiplies section coordinates by its structural image and induces that scalar action on cohomology. Let $\beta:k'\otimes_k H^1(G)\to H^1(G')$ be any $k'$-linear map such that $\beta(b\otimes x)=b\cdot H^1(q)(j^*x)$ for every $b\in k'$ and $x\in H^1(G)$. For every $z\in k'\otimes_k H^1(G)$, $\beta(z)=0$ implies $z=0$.

source.place: coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology, separated-case finite affine cover proof; Theorem 03P2, separated-case cohomology comparison

proof.text: Identify G and G' with the lifted associated structure sheaves by their natural section coordinates. The section scalar formulas determine the scalar endomorphisms uniquely, so the scalar-natural coefficient and etale/Zariski comparisons give the structural scalar actions on cohomology.

Choose a finite affine cover of C; quasi-compactness and separatedness follow from IsCurve. All finite intersections and their inverse images on C' are affine. Affine tensor sections identify the pulled-back Cech complex with k' tensor the original. The adjoint section formula hq and the natural inverse-image Cech comparison identify the induced cohomology map with H(q) after canonical etale Ext pullback. Its tensor-linear extension is β because the two maps agree on all pure tensors.

Tensoring over the field k is exact, so cycles and boundaries of the tensor complex are the tensors of the original cycles and boundaries. Under the natural Cech comparisons a class in the kernel of β is a tensor-boundary and hence zero in tensor homology. This proves triviality of the kernel. The unique isomorphism to the categorical pullback transports the construction to the displayed square.

theorem additive_cohomology_tensor_kernel
    {k k' : Type u}
    [Field k] [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsCurve f]
    {C' : Scheme.{u}} {f' : C' ⟶ Spec (.of k')} {ι' : C' ⟶ C}
    (h : IsPullback ι' f' f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))))
    (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G' : Sheaf C'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (a' : ∀ U : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ, G'.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
    (ha : ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
      a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x))
    (ha' : ∀ (U V : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G'.obj.obj U),
      a' V (G'.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a' U x))
    (q : (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').obj G ⟶ G')
    (hq : (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
        a' (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ ι').obj U.unop))
          (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ι').homEquiv
            G G' q).hom.app U x) =
          (Limits.pullback.fst U.unop.hom ι').appTop (a U x)))
    [Module k (Sheaf.H G 1)] [Module k' (Sheaf.H G' 1)]
    (hscalar : ∀ c : k, ∃ μ : G ⟶ G,
        (∀ (U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G.obj.obj U),
          let ρ : k →+* Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤) := U.unop.hom.appTop.hom.comp
            (f.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom)
          a U (μ.hom.app U x) = a U x * ρ c) ∧
        ∀ x : Sheaf.H G 1,
          Sheaf.H.map μ 1 x = c • x)
    (hscalar' : ∀ c : k', ∃ μ : G' ⟶ G',
        (∀ (U : C'.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : G'.obj.obj U),
          let ρ : k' →+* Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤) := U.unop.hom.appTop.hom.comp
            (f'.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k')).inv.hom)
          a' U (μ.hom.app U x) = a' U x * ρ c) ∧
        ∀ x : Sheaf.H G' 1,
          Sheaf.H.map μ 1 x = c • x)
    (β : (k' ⊗[k] Sheaf.H G 1) →ₗ[k'] Sheaf.H G' 1)
    (hβ : ∀ (b : k') (x : Sheaf.H G 1),
      β (b ⊗ₜ[k] x) = b • Sheaf.H.map q 1 (Etale.cohomologyMap ι' G 1 x)) :
    ∀ z, β z = 0 → z = 0
